thread:
maria_cs: FYI customer acme-prod is seeing a surge of 429s + request queueing on their Dedicated pool since ~08:45 UTC. They say scale-up isn’t keeping up and requests are timing out. Ticket #INC-6591.

devon_oncall: Copy. Any quick repro info from the customer?

maria_cs: They supplied a repro: ~300 RPS sustained on a 2-GPU pool with min_replicas=1, max_replicas=8, autoscale policy = latency SLO target 120ms. Most requests hit queuing and then 429 after ~15s. They say warmup tokens show cold starts on new nodes.

eli_sre: Do we have deploy/autoscaler logs for that pool? Could be hitting min_replicas floor + long node startup + model load time.

paul_support: I pulled the pool events at 08:47-08:55 UTC — autoscaler triggered scale-up but new workers reported "model_load_time=~24s" and Kubernetes readiness probe delayed. That plus request queueing looks like cold-start backlog.

sam_runtime: Can we see the model variant they’re using and if it’s quantized? Non-quantized LLMs can take longer to load and inflate scale-up time.

maria_cs: They’re on gpt-small-fp16 (non-quantized), 2xA100 equivalent.

deploy-bot: [autoscaler] pool=acme-prod-dedicated event=scaleup request_replicas=4 -> 3 provisioned, 1 pending (ts=1840000456)

eli_sre: Okay. Two likely contributors: (1) min_replicas=1 means only a single warm node — burst causes autoscaler to request more but provision+model load > SLO, (2) readiness probe uses full model warm check which waits for full KV cache build.

devon_oncall: Customer is asking for mitigation now — what do we recommend asap?

sam_runtime: Short-term workaround: increase min_replicas to 2-3 for that pool to keep additional warm capacity. Also enable "burst_capacity" if they have headroom on account. Medium-term: use quantized variant or prewarm hooks.

maria_cs: I suggested min_replicas=3 and flagged that it may increase monthly committed cost; customer approved trying a 1-hour test.

paul_support: Logging snippet from the node that failed readiness:
```
2026-03-17T08:47:12Z model_loader INFO start loading model gpt-small-fp16
2026-03-17T08:47:37Z cache_manager INFO building kv cache: estimated=18s
2026-03-17T08:48:00Z readiness_probe WARN probe timeout (10s)
2026-03-17T08:48:36Z model_loader INFO warm complete
```

eli_sre: That matches - model load + KV build > probe timeout. Two actionable items: increase readiness timeout to account for KV build OR change readiness to a lighter health check and gate traffic until warm-complete via router. But latter requires careful rollout.

devon_oncall: For immediate mitigation I’ll change min_replicas to 3 on the pool and extend readinessProbe.timeoutSeconds to 40. Will monitor.

maria_cs: Customer ok with that. They asked for reproducible steps so they can try locally — provided quick curl example we gave them:
```
# simulate burst
for i in {1..300}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPO_API_KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"gpt-small-fp16","input":"hello"}' &
done
```

paul_support: Also called out that their client retries are aggressive; recommend exponential backoff instead of immediate retry flooding the queue.

devon_oncall: After changing min_replicas -> 3 and probe timeout -> 40, deploy-bot reports:

deploy-bot: [autoscaler] pool=acme-prod-dedicated config_update=min_replicas=3 readiness_timeout=40

deploy-bot: [autoscaler] pool=acme-prod-dedicated event=scaleup request_replicas=4 -> 4 provisioned (ts=1840000660)

eli_sre: New nodes came up with warm completion in ~26s but traffic distribution was smoother; still see a short tail of 429s during ramp. Suggest medium-term: recommend quantized variant + enable prefix/KV caching + plan for prewarm hook in Dedicated config.

sam_runtime: Filed RFC item for autoscaler to consider model_load_time metric when deciding desired replicas (so we can anticipate and pre-provision for models with long load times).

maria_cs: Customer happy with temporary fix. They asked for a summary and next steps.

paul_support: Summary sent to customer: (1) increased min_replicas to 3 temporarily, (2) extended readiness probe to 40s to avoid false failover, (3) recommending quantized model and backoff in client, (4) engineering exploring autoscaler improvement and prewarm hooks. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Closing loop. Marking INC-6591 as mitigated; will monitor for 12h then propose long-term plan with customer.

devon_oncall: Thanks team. Follow-ups: @sam_runtime please paste RFC link when ready.

sam_runtime: Will do — RFC will reference autoscaler heuristics and a prewarm API.
